title: Move ownership
summary: Rust: Move ownership. Try reading first after the move and read the compiler message.
introduction: A String owns its text. Assigning it to another variable moves that ownership.
learningObjectives: Try reading first after the move and read the compiler message

blocks.text: Install stable Rust. Save each example as lesson.rs, run rustc lesson.rs, then run the created program.

blocks.title: Move ownership

blocks.text: Assigning first to second moves ownership of the String. second is now its usable owner.
Try reading first after the move and read the compiler message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not use a String binding after its value has moved.
